Gemini vs VEXI: Chat AI or Social Media Done in One App?
Gemini and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Gemini is Google's AI assistant, and it makes images and videos too [1][2][3]. Here is how it compares with one app that runs your social media.

Gemini is Google's AI assistant [1]. It helps craft scripts and social copy, makes and edits images, and on paid plans generates videos and edits them by chat [1][2][3]. Plans run from $0 a month, through Google AI Plus at $4.99 a month and Google AI Pro at $19.99 a month, to Google AI Ultra from $99.99 a month [1].

VEXI is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The difference is the job each is built for. Gemini is a broad assistant for writing, research, images and video [1]. VEXI is service as software: you ask once, and the post comes back written, designed, edited and scheduled. VEXI costs more than Gemini: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month [1]. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Gemini generates videos from text, photos or video, and edits them by chat: swap the background, adjust the lighting or stabilize the shot [3].
Send VEXI the clips you shot and they come back cut, with B-roll, music and captions, sized for each platform.
Gemini helps craft scripts, generate social copy and turn your files into new content ideas, such as social captions and blog posts [1].
VEXI Autopilot runs your week ahead: it writes, cuts and posts, and can wait for your approval on everything.
Edits your own footage: cuts, B-roll, music, captions
A broad AI assistant that writes, makes and edits images, and generates and edits video, starting at $0 a month with a Google Account [1][2][3].
One app: you ask, and it writes, designs, edits the video and posts it. Autopilot runs your week ahead.
Can Gemini make social media videos?
On paid plans, Gemini generates videos from text, photos or video, and edits them by chat [1][3]. It also helps craft scripts and social copy [1].

Gemini starts at $0 a month with a Google Account [1]. Google AI Plus is $4.99 a month, Google AI Pro is $19.99 a month, and Google AI Ultra starts at $99.99 a month, with a $199.99 tier for higher limits [1].
